task: estimate same-day basin daily-max 8h O3 (ppb) from cross-pollutant network means + calendar (estimation, not forecasting)
interpretation: Best holdout RMSE: random_forest (6.669 ppb vs mean-baseline 12.054). OLS coefficients are per-SD effects from the training fold; Durbin-Watson = 0.92 confirms residual autocorrelation, so OLS p-values (independence assumption) should be read with caution. Associations describe this dataset; they do not establish causation.
